visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Characters & Micro-Actions: A Black man with short hair and a black scarf/turtleneck smiles broadly while holding a Starbucks holiday cup toward the camera in a selfie-style shot. Behind him, three other Black men stand in a group, one wearing a red baseball cap and another in a light plaid shirt; they are smiling and gesturing. Objects: A red and white Starbucks holiday cup is the central object. Setting: A dimly lit indoor lounge or hallway with a green neon light visible in the background. Text: Large teal and white captions appear at the top. (2) Characters & Micro-Actions: The video transitions to a 2D graphic animation. A yellow silhouette character is handed a cup by an arm reaching into the frame. Later, the character appears happy holding a "hot" coffee and neutral/sad holding an "ice" coffee. A cartoon young man in a blue t-shirt points with his right hand. Objects: Illustrated coffee cups and a personality evaluation sheet. Setting: Flat graphic backgrounds of a university building and office interiors. Text: "Yale University" in Chinese appears on a building. (3) Characters & Micro-Actions: Return to the real-life footage. The narrator passes the Starbucks cup to his friends. One friend takes a sip and smiles; another man in a blue cap takes the cup and poses confidently. The group is laughing and interacting warmly. Objects: The Starbucks cup is passed between the men. Setting: The same dimly lit indoor venue with soft green background lighting. Text: Large white subtitles occupy the bottom third of the frame.
